business_model: B2B SaaS subscription; Team plan 5,000 USD per month per workspace with unlimited agents, Enterprise custom
product_category: No code governed AI agent platform

technical_complexity.rationale: Governed agent builder with citations, deterministic primitives, audit logging, bring your own model and on-prem options; standard engineering plus compliance work (SOC 2 Type II, HIPAA claimed).

defensibility.rationale: Compliance posture and workflow lock in help, but large platforms such as Microsoft Copilot Studio, which Clarm itself compares against, offer similar builders.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Incumbent builders exist and Clarm positions against them; no acquisition or copying event found.

market_need_then: Regulated industries want AI with auditability; the site cites a fertility clinic with 8x usage growth and a produce multinational entering 1,000 plus orders in seven weeks (company claims).

brand_strength.rationale: Name has no sourced origin and is close to Claris, Charm and others; no press on the brand itself.
